title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature is crucial for handling JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling yantraverse to support a wider range of use cases and improving its usability. It will parse the request body and populate the request object with the parsed data. This feature will enhance the framework's functionality and make it more production-ready
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the request body is correctly parsed for JSON and URL-encoded data, and error handling is properly implemented for invalid request bodies
reason: Implementing request body parsing is a high-impact feature that improves the framework's usability and supports real-world use cases, making it a priority for feature development
